subject.title: Per-agent compaction and contextPruning overrides in agents.list

question: Should OpenClaw support `agents.list[].compaction` and `agents.list[].contextPruning` as a public per-agent config contract, and should #88506 be the landing path?
rationale: The source-reproduced gap is real, but adding this config surface changes public config, provider routing, and session-context behavior, so automation should not create another fix path without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the additive per-agent contract
options.body: Approve the config direction, require deep-merge semantics plus docs/tests/upgrade proof, and use #88506 or a replacement as the repair path.

options.title: Narrow the first contract
options.body: Accept only a smaller per-agent compaction model override first and defer broad compaction/contextPruning merge semantics to a later design item.

options.title: Keep defaults-only behavior
options.body: Decline the config expansion and close or redirect the linked implementation PRs while documenting the supported alternatives.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the additive per-agent contract
recommendation.body: Approve the config direction, require deep-merge semantics plus docs/tests/upgrade proof, and use #88506 or a replacement as the repair path.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent commits in the schema/defaults/agent-scope helpers where the public contract would land.
